note: Printed words that name a control drawn directly above them, and how to locate that control on the current frame. This file holds IDENTITY and a RELATION, never a click position: 'template_path' is a picture of the control, matched on the frame in front of the run, and the tap target is wherever the match IS. Constitution A §24.2 forbids a stored coordinate as a tap target and §24.4 forbids reading a historical position to click; §24.3 explicitly allows a bounded search region, which is what 'search' records. A record may also carry 'allow_measured_block': true, which lets the measured-block gate run when no crop exists yet -- it is off by default because that gate failed its own calibration (see docs/LOCAL_PLANNER_ACCEPTANCE.md §7).

refused_on_purpose.label: 立即完成
refused_on_purpose.reason: it is a 大额宝石 purchase. On 城墙 it prints 15,699 and on 士兵训练加速 8,292, and it is the orange gem-cost pill in both. OPERATIONAL.md puts 大额宝石 in the Strict tier (门禁不放宽, §8) and PRINCIPLES.md requires 钻石 to pass the Risk Gate when unauthorised. Registering it with label_is_the_control would make it freely tappable by any planner reply that names it, which is a gate removal this project does not do by registry entry
refused_on_purpose.occurrences_reviewed: 2 occurrences in the ledgers, both the same orange gem-cost button: 城墙 (15,699) and 士兵训练加速 (8,292)
refused_on_purpose.consequence: a model proposal to tap it still comes back PLAN_TARGET_IS_NOT_A_CONTROL and is refused, which is the safe direction: refusing twice costs a turn, spending gems cannot be undone
